description: Add investigation UI to frontend (index.html, style.css). This feature creates the 2-question dialog, candidate selection interface, and provenance display, all integrated into the existing upload workspace without breaking the two-PDF comparison workflow. The UI follows the existing design system (CSS custom properties, vanilla JS, no frameworks) and uses the same upload box style for single-file mode.
steps:
1. Add investigation mode toggle to frontend/templates/index.html upload-workspace section: After 'Compare Two Versions' header, add radio button group:
. When 'investigate' selected, hide uploadA box, show only uploadB box, change button text to 'Start Investigation'

2. Add investigation dialog HTML to index.html (initially hidden with class='hidden'):

Help us find the earlier policy

Answer two questions so we can search authoritative sources:

3. Add candidate selection UI HTML to index.html (initially hidden):

Found candidate policies

Select the earlier version to compare:

4. Add investigation result labels to comparison results: When rendering stats, add source labels: 'Earlier policy: <discovered-title> (discovered from <domain>)' and 'Newer policy: <filename> (uploaded)'. Show provenance status badge next to discovered policy

5. Add CSS to frontend/static/style.css for investigation UI: .mode-toggle {display:flex;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;} .mode-toggle label {cursor:pointer;padding:0.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all 0.2s;} .mode-toggle input:checked + label {background:var(--accent-light);border-color:var(--accent);} .investigation-dialog {position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:200;} .dialog-content {background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:2rem;max-width:600px;width:90%;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);} .form-group {display:grid;gap:0.75rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;} .form-group label {font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;} .form-group input {padding:0.625rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;} .candidate-list {background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:2rem;margin-bottom:2rem;} .candidate-item {border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:1.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;} .candidate-item:hover {border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-light);} .candidate-title {font-weight:700;font-size:var(--text-lg);margin-bottom:0.5rem;} .candidate-meta {font-size:var(--text-sm);color:var(--text-secondary);margin-bottom:0.75rem;} .provenance-badge {display:inline-block;padding:0.25rem 0.75rem;border-radius:6px;font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;margin-top:0.5rem;} .provenance-verified {background:var(--color-added-light);color:var(--color-added);} .provenance-strong {background:var(--color-wording-light);color:var(--color-wording);} .provenance-limited {background:var(--color-changed-light);color:var(--color-changed);} .provenance-unverified {background:var(--color-removed-light);color:var(--color-removed);} .provenance-signals {font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:0.5rem;}

6. Add JavaScript investigation logic to index.html <script> section: Add global let investigationSessionId = null; let investigationMode = 'compare'; Add event listener for mode toggle radio buttons to set investigationMode and show/hide uploadA box. Modify $('#compare').onclick to check investigationMode: if 'investigate', upload only newFile to /investigate/start, store session_id, show investigation dialog; if 'compare', keep existing logic unchanged

7. Add investigation form submit handler: $('#investigation-form').onsubmit = async (e) => {e.preventDefault(); collect form values; POST to /investigate/context with session_id and form data; on success, hide dialog, show loading notice, POST to /investigate/search with session_id; on success, render candidates}

8. Add renderCandidates(candidates) function: For each candidate, create .candidate-item div with candidate.title, candidate.institution_name + candidate.university_name, candidate.source_domain, provenance badge based on candidate.provenance_status (VERIFIED_PROVENANCE -> 'Verified', STRONG_PROVENANCE -> 'Strong', LIMITED_PROVENANCE -> 'Limited', UNVERIFIED -> 'Unverified'), provenance_signals summary (e.g. 'Domain: Official university • Title match: 92% • Date: Confirmed earlier'). On click, call confirmCandidate(index)

9. Add confirmCandidate(index) function: POST to /investigate/confirm with session_id and candidate_index; on success, receives comparison result; call existing load(result) function to render comparison; add investigation metadata to comparison header showing discovered policy source and provenance status

10. Add cancel/manual upload handlers: $('#cancel-investigation').onclick clears session, hides dialog, returns to upload screen. $('#upload-manually').onclick hides candidate list, shows 'Please upload the earlier policy manually' message with file input, on file selected uploads both files to /compare as normal two-PDF flow
acceptance_criteria: Mode toggle radio buttons switch between 'Compare two versions' and 'Find earlier version'
In investigate mode, only uploadB (newer policy) box is visible
Investigation dialog appears after uploading newer policy, prompts for 2 questions (institution + university, policy title + optional department/year)
Candidate list displays up to 5 candidates with title, institution, domain, provenance badge, and provenance signals summary
Clicking a candidate triggers /investigate/confirm, then loads comparison results using existing comparison UI
Comparison results show source labels: discovered policy vs uploaded policy, with provenance badge on discovered policy
Manual upload option allows user to exit investigation flow and upload earlier policy themselves
Existing two-PDF comparison workflow unchanged when 'Compare two versions' mode selected
All investigation UI follows existing design system (colors, typography, spacing, transitions)
Investigation dialog is accessible (keyboard navigation, ARIA labels)
verification: Verify default mode is 'Compare two versions' and both upload boxes visible
Switch to 'Find earlier version' mode; verify uploadA box hidden, uploadB box visible, button text changed
Upload a PDF in investigate mode; verify dialog appears with 2-question form

Fill form with test data (Institution: 'Greenfield University', University: 'Greenfield', Title: 'Academic Integrity Policy'); submit; verify candidate list appears (may be empty if SERPER_API_KEY not set or no results found)
Switch back to 'Compare two versions' mode; upload 2 PDFs; verify existing comparison works unchanged
Test keyboard navigation: Tab through dialog fields, Enter to submit, Escape to cancel
